summary: Stalled admission authority no longer blocks public shutdown beyond its deadline or publishes Open in the controlled scenario; independent eight-case registry verification passes. Broader concurrency and provider cleanup remain unfinished.

final_shape.production: Shutdown latch and bounded gate acquisition satisfy the stalled admission case. Separate final latch check/publication can race, and hold release after timed-out gate acquisition remains unresolved; reported before group completion.
final_shape.test: Public provider handshake, release and bounded observation verify the controlled scenario without private hooks or elapsed-time assertions. Existing seven cases preserved; no refactor needed.
